newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - VIISNURK H1 NET PROFIT 6.8 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - VIISNURK H1 NET PROFIT 6.8 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Estonian ski producer Viisnurk said on Tuesday it made a net profit of 6.8 million kroons in the first six months compared with a net loss of 2.6 million kroons in the same period last year.
The company is sticking to its profit estimate schedule, it added in a statement. Its 1997 profit forecast is 10 million kroons.
Viisnurk's net turnover was 79 million kroons after six months, a rise of 1.66 times compared with the same period last year. The net turnover of its ski factory has risen up to four times.
Viisnurk's assets grew by 22.8 percent during the six months to 143 million kroons, the company added.
